subject.title: Draft: add read-only CLI catalog and operator views

question: Should the first core catalog expose centrally maintained risk and effect classifications, or only factual metadata derived from existing command, tool, and plugin owners?
rationale: The linked RFC intentionally leaves the public boundary open, and accepting a separate advisory registry creates lasting ownership and compatibility commitments that code review cannot choose.

options.title: Ship factual inventory only
options.body: Remove the five hand-authored advisory classifications and keep the output experimental until canonical owners expose shared metadata.

options.title: Add canonical owner metadata
options.body: Define typed metadata at each command or tool owner and make both runtime and catalog projections consume that single source.

options.title: Accept the central overlay
options.body: Keep the advisory registry as a supported core contract with explicit maintainers and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Ship factual inventory only
recommendation.body: Remove the five hand-authored advisory classifications and keep the output experimental until canonical owners expose shared metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and explicit discussion routing make them the strongest available owner for the core product and API boundary decision.
